findings: All three sheets visible; Sheet2 and Sheet3 empty. No hidden rows, hidden columns, notes, formulas, external-link packages, embedded objects or additional chart data sources found.

Sheet1 records animal labels and individual numeric readings at pre-model and weeks1–4 for model, another control-labelled block, and sham. It records no measurement dates, BP subtype, unit, batch labels, failure/exclusion reasons, or technical-read averaging status.

Model has 24 labelled rows; control has 14 labelled rows (including one with no readings); sham has 10 complete labelled rows. Independent sample size and allocation into current model/restoration/SCG cohorts cannot be established from these labels alone.

Normalizing only the suffix 号 flags model labels10 and25 twice within the model-labelled block; ?21 remains ambiguous. Repeated labels across blocks may reflect reused identifiers/batches rather than identical animals and cannot be merged without confirmation.
Model and control contain time-specific missing cells. Missingness causes are unrecorded. Empty cells must not be replaced by zero or treated as deaths/exclusions.
Restoration has only hardcoded week5–8 values138,120,110,100 in G33:J33. No individual restoration records, sample sizes, SD/SEM, or pre-restoration same-animal baseline values are provided.

Both native line charts use typed summary rows31–33 rather than the individual-reading blocks. Chart caches agree with referenced summary cells, but summary model/sham values disagree with arithmetic means of the labelled numeric cells. No formulas connect these roles.

All five chart-labelled sham inputs in B32:F32 exactly match, to one decimal, the available-reading means of the differently labelled control block I2:M15, with time-specific counts10,7,11,6,10. They do not match the separate sham10 rowsP2:T11. This numerical match identifies a candidate source, not proof which control-labelled block belongs to the manuscript.

Four model-labelled rows16,23,24,25 have baseline and week4 readings with <20% increase (approximately -3.39%,10.34%,12.5%,19.44%), inconsistent with including every labelled row as a successfully selected animal under the previously confirmed criterion. No post-hoc exclusions applied.
Neither chart contains error bars. No endpoint-specific SD/SEM or effective n is saved with typed summary rows.
Worksheet contains labels up to84; arbitrary animal label numbers do not by themselves establish total cohort size or invalidate60-rat design, but do not identify the manuscript subset either.

Legacy early Fig1 is a three-bar endpoint image with approximately sham111/model142/restoration124mmHg. This workbook terminal summary values sham121.4/model142.4/restoration100 are not a matching three-group numeric source; approximate image heights are not exact recovered data.

The author-confirmed current endpoint schedule is sham/modelday28 and restorationday56. This workbook can describe weeks0–4 source rows, but it cannot verify the manuscript endpoint restoration distribution or source subset. A full contemporaneous day56 model vs restoration comparison is absent.
analysis_strategy_without_p_values: Before inference, author/source mapping must identify which labelled animals/batch are used in this manuscript, clarify duplicate labels and the additional control-labelled block, confirm mmHg/SBP, and explain missing values and technical averaging.

If row identifiers are confirmed stable same animals across weeks and selected groups identified, use a longitudinal model with animal random intercept and categorical group/time; mixed models can include observed values under a defensible missing-data mechanism. Assess residuals/model assumptions and multiplicity. Do not silently select complete cases or treat weeks as independent animals.

For current terminal sham/modelday28 and restorationday56, report each group own time and valid n. Any between-terminal-group test is an exploratory group-and-time contrast and cannot isolate restoration treatment from elapsed time; missing day56 contemporaneous model/sham controls cannot be created.
A within-restoration day28-to56 paired change requires both readings tied to each same animal. The four group summary means alone do not support paired variance or a longitudinal test.

Some unpaired tests could use actual means/SD/n summary inputs if genuine and source-matched; these restoration summary inputs contain neither SD nor n. No formal test or p value calculated in this audit.
Disclose BP overlap with prior2026AngII publication and avoid presenting shared readings as independent replication.
